title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: recommended thresholds in the policy wizard
summary: The briefing accurately separates the roadmap's planned change from the related preview documented by Microsoft Learn. The policy control path reaches the correct policy list but should continue into the policy editor to the threshold option.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans tailored recommended thresholds for all built-in indicators in the Insider Risk Management policy wizard for administrators with appropriate permissions.
claims.quote: With this update, admins with the appropriate permissions can get tailored recommended thresholds for all the built-in indicators within the policy wizard.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the aim as fine-tuning insider risk policies to obtain an optimal number of alerts.
claims.quote: This feature enables organizations to fine tune their insider risk policies and get an optimal number of alerts.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; rationale: risk; Open questions
claims.claim: The default state on arrival of the roadmap change is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "recommended thresholds" "default" rollout existing policies; read the roadmap record and Learn policy-indicators, analytics and configure pages. Preview configuration is described, but no arrival default is given for this roadmap change.

claims.claim: Learn does not identify a separately documented feature under the roadmap item's name.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "recommended thresholds" "477363"; opened policy-indicators, analytics and configure. Results describe real-time analytics recommendations and inline alert customization, not a separately identified roadmap feature.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly identified the roadmap item as the general availability of the real-time analytics preview.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "recommended thresholds" "477363"; read the record and Learn policy-indicators, configure and analytics. No passage links the item to graduation of the documented preview.

claims.claim: No source states that arrival of this roadmap change alters existing policies or thresholds.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "recommended thresholds" "default" rollout existing policies; opened policy-indicators, configure, analytics and policies and read the record. User-selected changes are described, but no automatic rollout change to existing thresholds is stated.

claims.claim: The roadmap change's rollout mechanics and actual per-cloud release availability are not stated beyond its planned cloud list.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "threshold" "recommendations" GCC availability admin switch; read the record, policy-indicators, configure and analytics. The record lists planned clouds, not cloud-specific rollout windows or actual availability.

claims.claim: The planning page describes Insider Risk Management as part of a wide selection of Microsoft 365 subscriptions.
claims.quote: Microsoft offers Insider Risk Management as part of a wide selection of Microsoft 365 licensing subscriptions.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The service description and planning page have no recommended-thresholds entry, and no feature-specific add-on licence is published.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "recommended thresholds" licensing price; read the service description's Insider Risk Management table, plan, configure, policy-indicators and billing-models pages. Product licences are documented, but no separate entitlement for threshold recommendations was found.

claims.claim: No separate meter or price for recommended thresholds is published.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "recommended thresholds" licensing price; "recommended thresholds" "billing". Opened service description, plan, configure, policy-indicators and purview-billing-models; no meter or price for generating threshold recommendations was found.

claims.claim: Some Insider Risk Management indicators require pay-as-you-go billing.
claims.quote: Some indicators included in Insider Risk Management are only available if you enable the pay-as-you-go billing model for your organization.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not state whether indicator pay-as-you-go billing affects the threshold recommendations themselves.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "recommended thresholds" licensing price; "recommended thresholds" "billing". Read configure, policy-indicators and purview-billing-models. Billing covers non-Microsoft 365 activity processing; no statement bills threshold recommendations.

claims.claim: The tenant analytics control is in Microsoft Purview portal at Settings > Insider Risk Management > Insider risk settings > Analytics.
claims.quote: Select Settings in the upper-right corner of the page. ... Select Insider Risk Management ... Under Insider risk settings, select Analytics, and then turn off the setting.

claims.claim: No automation operation for enabling or disabling insider risk analytics is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management analytics enable PowerShell API Set-InsiderRiskManagementAnalyticsPolicy recommended thresholds; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell "InsiderRisk" "Analytics". Read analytics and configure; no analytics-setting command or endpoint found.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Insider Risk Management > Policies reaches the policies whose workflow contains the threshold control.
claims.quote: Go to the Insider Risk Management solution. ... Select Policies in the left navigation. ... Select Create policy to open the policy workflow.
claims.fix: The path stops at the correct policy list. Give the existing-policy route in full: "Insider Risk Management > Policies > policy > Edit policy > Indicators > Apply thresholds specific to your users' activity". Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-policies for entry to Edit policy and https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-settings-policy-indicators for the preview's Indicators option; add the policies page to sources.

claims.claim: No command or API operation for selecting recommended policy thresholds is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider risk management recommended thresholds policy PowerShell API configure thresholds; site:learn.microsoft.com "insider risk" "thresholds" "API". Read policy-indicators, configure and settings search excerpts; APIs found concern alerts, not threshold configuration.

claims.claim: Role membership is configured in Microsoft Purview portal at Settings > Roles and groups > Roles groups > Insider Risk Management > Edit > Choose users.
claims.quote: Select Settings ... select Roles and groups, then select Roles groups ... Select the Insider Risk Management role group, then select Edit. ... Select Choose users

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember -Identity "Insider Risk Management" -Member "<user-UPN>" adds a user to that management role group.
claims.quote: Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group. ... The Identity parameter specifies the role group to add a member to. ... User ID or user principal name (UPN)

claims.claim: Members of Insider Risk Management, Insider Risk Management Admins or Microsoft 365 Global admin can enable analytics.
claims.quote: To enable insider risk analytics, you must be a member of the Insider Risk Management, Insider Risk Management Admins, or Microsoft 365 Global admin role group.

claims.claim: Learn labels the related real-time analytics threshold recommendations as preview.
claims.quote: Use real-time analytics (preview) to get a guided, data-driven threshold configuration experience.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The documented real-time analytics preview requires insider risk analytics insights to be enabled.
claims.quote: To use real-time analytics (preview), you must enable insider risk analytics insights.

claims.claim: Turning on analytics enables Apply thresholds specific to your users' activity on the Indicators page of the policy workflow.
claims.quote: When you turn on analytics: ... The Apply thresholds specific to your users' activity option is enabled on the Indicators page of the policy workflow.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The preview's recommendations are based on the previous 10 days of organization user activity.
claims.quote: Select this option if you want Insider Risk Management to provide indicator threshold recommendations based on the previous 10 days of user activity in your organization.

claims.claim: With analytics enabled, Choose your own thresholds starts from recommended organization-specific values instead of built-in default values.
claims.quote: If you select the Choose your own thresholds option ... the defaults for the threshold settings are based on recommended threshold values (based on activity in your organization) instead of the built-in default values.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The preview shows a gauge estimating the number of scoped users whose activity exceeded the lowest daily thresholds for a selected built-in indicator.
claims.quote: The gauge shows the approximate number of scoped users whose activities from the previous 10 days exceeded the lowest daily thresholds for at least one of the selected built-in indicators for the policy.

claims.claim: The preview displays a top-five indicator list.
claims.quote: You also see a gauge, a list of the top five indicators, and insights for each indicator.

claims.claim: Per-indicator insights estimate the number of users exceeding the indicator's low thresholds.
claims.quote: The insight shows the approximate number of users whose activities from the previous 10 days exceeded the specified low thresholds for the indicator.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Policy authors can select or manually adjust thresholds in the preview workflow before activating policies.
claims.quote: If you select the Choose your own thresholds option and manually adjust a threshold setting for a specific indicator, the insight for the indicator updates in real time.

claims.claim: The recommended-threshold option requires selection of at least one built-in policy indicator.
claims.quote: To use this option, you must select at least one built-in policy indicator.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Analytics scans Microsoft 365 audit logs.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 audit logs: Included in all scans, this primary source helps you identify most of the potentially risky activities.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Analytics scans Exchange Online activity.
claims.quote: Exchange Online: Included in all scans, Exchange Online activity helps you identify activities where data in attachments are emailed to external contacts or services.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Analytics scans Microsoft Entra ID history.
claims.quote: Microsoft Entra ID: Included in all scans, Microsoft Entra history helps you identify risky activities associated with users with deleted user accounts.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Analytics uses Microsoft 365 HR connector events if that connector is configured.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 HR data connector: If configured, HR connector events help you identify risky activities associated with users that have resignation or upcoming termination dates.

claims.claim: Analytics scan results and insights are aggregated and anonymized user activity.

claims.claim: Reviewers cannot identify individual usernames from those analytics scan results.
claims.quote: Reviewers can't identify individual usernames.

claims.claim: Disabling analytics removes the real-time analytics view while customizing policy indicator thresholds.
claims.quote: When you disable analytics: ... You can't see real-time analytics when you customize indicator threshold settings for your policies.

claims.claim: The documented recommended-threshold option is selected in each policy's workflow.
claims.quote: The Apply thresholds specific to your users' activity option is enabled on the Indicators page of the policy workflow. Select this option if you want Insider Risk Management to provide indicator threshold recommendations

claims.claim: Learn documents no separate administrator switch for recommended thresholds beyond the analytics prerequisite and per-policy option.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "threshold" "recommendations" GCC availability admin switch; Insider risk management recommended thresholds policy PowerShell API configure thresholds. Read analytics, configure, policy-indicators and settings excerpts; no separate switch found.

claims.claim: The recommendations discussed here are an administrator-facing policy-authoring experience, rather than a new end-user experience.
claims.quote: admins with the appropriate permissions can get tailored recommended thresholds for all the built-in indicators within the policy wizard.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Indicator threshold choices influence alert volume, which supplies the factual premise for the briefing's analyst-capacity advice.
claims.quote: The guided experience helps you efficiently adjust the selection of indicators and thresholds for activity occurrences so you don't have too few or too many policy alerts.
